summary: Risk sentiment is bearish today: a hawkish Federal Reserve hold, sharply higher December hike expectations, mixed technology earnings, and Middle East tensions are pressuring crypto and equities.[3][4][7] Bitcoin is testing the $80,000 area while altcoins are weaker, with the Altcoin Season Index falling to 28 and roughly 270 of the top 300 tokens down over the past week.[1][9]
